Decision-model price-performance frontier

Score axis: Decision Index. Cost: USD per 1M input tokens (list price).

Every score comes from a named external source (listed at the end) with its own snapshot date. Conclave runs no evaluations, and a model with no external score is listed as unscored, never estimated.

Score vs cost

  • On the frontier (filled)
  • Dominated (hollow)
  • Self-reported (diamond)
  • Frontier step line

1 scored model(s) list a cost of $0 and cannot sit on a log axis; they are in the table.

Cost is the list price in USD per million input tokens, the only basis any source publishes for decision models. It can mislead: the tokens one decision call uses depend on each vendor's prompt format and tokenizer and differ by up to 13x between vendors, so a lower per-token price can still mean a dearer decision.

Score vs median latency

Filled markers are on the price frontier above; latency is the source's published median per call.
